title: selliguea taeniata
intro: Selliguea taeniata, commonly known as the Rattlesnake fern or Lady fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea taeniata include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
